"You saved my spot?"

Pallavi grinned. "Six weeks ago you wouldn't even look at me."

"Obviously," Himani said, and was surprised to find she meant it.

14 Oct, night

Jyoti made me laugh so hard today that I snorted juice in the lab. JYOTI. The girl I wrote three whole pages about in July, all about how she was fake and too loud and showed off her neat notes.
I don't know when it changed. We wait at the same bus stop at 7:10 every morning, and she's my lab partner because of the alphabet. So I've seen her every single day for three months. I've seen her miss the bus and run. I've seen her cry over a chemistry test. The loud thing is just nervous, I think.
Today she saved me a seat on the bus without asking. I sat there without thinking twice.
I'm not going to reread July. Too embarrassing.
Ankita
